subject: spt-dy
title: SPT.DY.------AF.POST.
description: First of two diagrams in TRF(II)-36. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'The spiritual alignment of a given culture is directly related to the vibrational and dynamic factors which outline how a given time zone is understood. Thus, if the concept of transformation has anything to do with "actualness" of change, then this concept must also imply that the composite results of that change be addressed with regards for what they mean on a dynamic (i.e., cosmic-spiritual-practical) level. The solidification of an alternative spiritual affinity alignment is directly related to the concept of transformation.' The crossing diagrams how spiritual-dynamics structurally meets affinity-postulation at the alternative-spiritual-affinity-alignment scale: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) crossed with AF-POST (affinity postulation — the form's actual postulating-from-affinity). SPT-DY sits on the left with the subject-arrow; POL-P (political policies) at upper-center and CN-INFO (controlled information) at top-right with INFO-FM (information forum) further right as the upper-bridging chain. MT-INTR (multiple interpretation) sits centrally with (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation) at right as the bridging hub. AF-POST sits at center-right as partner-axis; INFO-CON (information convergence) at the right-bottom as the partner-side downward output. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) hangs at lower-left and RT-DY (reality dynamics) and DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture's center) at center-bottom as the subject-side downward chain. Structural argument: when spiritual-dynamics is crossed with affinity-postulation, the upper diagonal POL-P → CN-INFO → INFO-FM is the *spectacle-converting chain* — political-policies route through controlled-information into information-forum, the partner-side's working channel for converting spectacle into received form. MT-INTR → (R)INTR is the bridging hub: multiple-interpretation routes through the reality of interpretation. SPT-DY → T-C-IMP → RT-DY → DIS-C-CT is the subject-side downward chain — spiritual-dynamics routes through time-continuum-implications into reality-dynamics and finally into disintegration of a culture's center (Braxton's recurring suppression terminus). AF-POST → INFO-CON is the partner-axis's downward output. The structural argument: alternative-spiritual-affinity-alignment requires holding the bridging hub MT-INTR → (R)INTR open against the upper diagonal's pull into INFO-FM and against the subject-axis's terminal DIS-C-CT — the form's actual cosmic-spiritual-practical alignment lives in the bridging hub maintaining position, otherwise spiritual-dynamics absorbs affinity-postulation into the partner-axis's information-convergence alone while the subject-axis disconnects.
